sink.preCopyScript:
drop table if exists dbo.SimpleEmployeeData

create table dbo.SimpleEmployeeData
(
EmpID int primary key
,NamePrefix varchar(100)
,FirstName varchar(100)
,MiddleInitial varchar(100)
,LastName  varchar(100)
,Gender varchar(100)
,EMail varchar(100)
)
